segments.sn55.12:1.4: ‘ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, kālasseva uṭṭhāya pācīnamukho yāhi.
segments.sn55.12:1.5: So tvaṃ mā sobbhaṃ parivajjehi, mā papātaṃ, mā khāṇuṃ, mā kaṇḍakaṭhānaṃ [kaṇḍakaṃ ṭhānaṃ (pī. ka.)], mā candaniyaṃ, mā oḷigallaṃ.
segments.sn55.12:1.6: Yattha [yattheva (syā. kaṃ.), yāni vā (sī.)] papateyyāsi tattheva maraṇaṃ āgameyyāsi.
segments.sn55.12:1.7: Evaṃ tvaṃ, ambho purisa, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissasī’”ti.
segments.sn55.12:2.1: “Taṃ kho panetaṃ, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇānaṃ bālagamanametaṃ [bālānaṃ gamanametaṃ (sī.)] mūḷhagamanametaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati.
segments.sn55.12:2.2: Ahañca kho, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye udayagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ paññapemi;
segments.sn55.12:2.3: yā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
segments.sn55.12:3.3: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti –
segments.sn55.12:3.4: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti;
segments.sn55.12:3.7: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi … pe … samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
segments.sn55.12:3.8: Ayaṃ kho sā, bhikkhave, udayagāminī paṭipadā ekantanibbidāya … pe …
